title: Glessner's 18th Street chimney: date stone, crosses and coping re-set
items: On the Glessner house's 18th Street gable, the 1886 date stone is now the height HABS sheet 6 draws it, a little shorter, with a course of stone between it and the monogram above, as every photograph shows.
The two crosses beside the date now stand level at its middle, as the 1965 survey photograph shows them.
The gable's stone coping is 0.7 ft lower, so it meets the chimney just under the date stone instead of beside it.
